title: "`r params$title`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date())`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: default
params:
  qc: NULL
  title: "Per-sample QC report"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, dev = "png", dpi = 110)
library(ggplot2)
qc      <- params$qc
cells   <- qc$cells
summ    <- qc$summary
metrics <- qc$metrics
samples <- qc$samples
cells$sample <- factor(cells$sample, levels = samples)
has_qc  <- any(!is.na(cells$qc_pass))
has_cl  <- any(!is.na(cells$cluster))
plot_m  <- ifelse(metrics %in% seurassist::QC_LOG10_METRICS,
                  paste0(metrics, "_log2"), metrics)
n_s     <- length(samples)
```

`r n_s` sample(s): `r paste(samples, collapse = ", ")`.
`r if (!has_qc) "**No pass/fail information was exported: all plots show pre-QC data.**"`

# Summary

```{r summary-table}
cols <- c("sample", "n_cells", "n_pass", "n_fail", "pct_fail", "n_doublet",
          "pct_doublet")
knitr::kable(summ[, cols], row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Cells per sample and cells failing QC.")
med <- summ[, c("sample", grep("^median_", colnames(summ), value = TRUE))]
knitr::kable(med, row.names = FALSE, digits = 2,
             caption = "Median of each metric (`_pass`: after QC).")
```

```{r pct-fail, fig.height = 3.5}
if (has_qc) {
  ggplot(transform(summ, sample = factor(sample, levels = samples)),
         aes(x = sample, y = pct_fail)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#c62828") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "% cells failing QC", title = "Cells removed per sample") +
    seurassist::theme_qc() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
```

# Why cells were removed

```{r reasons, fig.height = 4.5}
bd <- qc$breakdown
if (!is.null(bd)) {
  fails <- bd[bd$reason != "pass", ]
  top   <- names(sort(tapply(fails$n_cells, fails$reason, sum), decreasing = TRUE))
  top   <- utils::head(top, 8)
  bd$reason <- ifelse(bd$reason %in% c("pass", top), bd$reason, "other")
  bd <- aggregate(pct_of_sample ~ sample + reason, bd, sum)
  bd$sample <- factor(bd$sample, levels = samples)
  bd <- bd[bd$reason != "pass", ]
  if (nrow(bd)) {
    ggplot(bd, aes(x = sample, y = pct_of_sample, fill = reason)) +
      geom_col() +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "% of sample's cells", fill = "reason") +
      seurassist::theme_qc() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else cat("No cells failed QC.")
}
```

Full table: `qc_removal_breakdown.csv`.

# Metric distributions across samples

```{r violins-before, fig.height = 2.2 * length(metrics) + 1}
seurassist::qc_violin_stack(cells, "sample", plot_m,
                            title = "All cells (before QC)", x_angle = 45)
```

```{r violins-after, fig.height = 2.2 * length(metrics) + 1}
if (has_qc)
  seurassist::qc_violin_stack(cells[cells$qc_pass %in% TRUE, ], "sample", plot_m,
                              title = "Cells passing QC", x_angle = 45)
```

# Counts versus genes

```{r scatter, fig.height = 2.6 * ceiling(n_s / 3) + 1}
sx <- metrics[1]
sy <- if (length(metrics) > 1) metrics[2] else NULL
if (!is.null(sy)) {
  thin <- function(d) {
    k <- qc$max_cells_plot
    if (nrow(d) <= k) d else d[unique(round(seq(1, nrow(d), length.out = k))), ]
  }
  d <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(cells, cells$sample), thin))
  d$status <- if (has_qc) ifelse(d$qc_pass %in% TRUE, "pass", "fail") else "all"
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[sx]], y = .data[[sy]], colour = status)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ sample, ncol = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(pass = "grey60", fail = "#d32f2f",
                                   all = "grey40")) +
    labs(x = seurassist::qc_metric_label(sx), y = seurassist::qc_metric_label(sy),
         colour = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha = 1))) +
    seurassist::theme_qc()
  if (sx %in% seurassist::QC_LOG10_METRICS) p <- p + scale_x_log10()
  if (sy %in% seurassist::QC_LOG10_METRICS) p <- p + scale_y_log10()
  p
}
```

# Thresholds used

```{r thresholds}
thr <- qc$thresholds
if (is.null(thr)) {
  cat("No threshold tables were exported.")
} else {
  keep <- intersect(c("sample", "group", "metric", "min_thr", "max_thr",
                      "n_cells", "method"), colnames(thr))
  knitr::kable(thr[, keep], row.names = FALSE, digits = 2)
}
```

```{r flags}
fl <- qc$flags
if (!is.null(fl)) {
  knitr::kable(fl[fl$status != "pass", ], row.names = FALSE, digits = 2,
               caption = "Clusters flagged by tier-1 (non-pass only).")
}
```

# Per-sample details

```{r per-sample, results = "asis", fig.height = 3.2 * ceiling(length(metrics) / 2)}
for (s in samples) {
  cat("\n\n## ", s, "\n\n")
  d <- cells[cells$sample == s, ]
  if (!any(!is.na(d$cluster))) {
    cat("No cluster column was exported for this sample.\n\n")
    next
  }
  t_s <- if (is.null(qc$thresholds)) NULL else
    qc$thresholds[qc$thresholds$sample == s, , drop = FALSE]
  f_s <- if (is.null(qc$flags)) NULL else
    qc$flags[qc$flags$sample == s, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.null(t_s) && !nrow(t_s)) t_s <- NULL
  if (!is.null(f_s) && !nrow(f_s)) f_s <- NULL
  panels <- lapply(metrics, function(m)
    seurassist::qc_violin_panel(d, "cluster", m, t_s, f_s,
                                show_legend = FALSE))
  print(ggpubr::ggarrange(plotlist = panels, ncol = min(2, length(panels)),
                          nrow = ceiling(length(panels) / 2)))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
